former training but requires auxiliary encoders and extra training overhead. Recent
approaches instead exploit representations from the generative model's own varia-

masked latent reconstruction, and horizontal-flip consistency, yielding semantically
discriminative, spatially structured dense features and sample-dependent class pos-

evidence.excerpt:
representations
early in training, then removes the increasingly detrimental alignment and reuses
detached composer posteriors for sample-dependent soft label conditioning. We
further uncover a hidden confound in soft label conditioning: averaging class
embeddings attenuates their magnitude, coupling semantic interpolation with con-
ditioning strength. This attenuation alone can substantially improve FID while
degrading Recall, revealing a non-semantic source of the apparent gain. CoV A
corrects this confound by restoring the hard-label magnitude, isolating posterior-
dependent directional semantics. CoV A adds only 8.5M training-only auxiliary
parameters (1.3% of SiT-XL/2) and introduces no inference-time overhead. On
ImageNet 256×256, CoV A reduces SiT-XL/2 FID from 17.2 to 7.4 (57%) in 400K
steps. With classifier-free guidance, it achieves an FID of2.03in only 400 epochs,
versus 2.06

into representations that are better suited for generative learning?To address this, we introduce

composer trained using complementary semantic and structural objectives, including class supervision,
masked latent reconstruction He et al. (2022), and horizontal-flip consistency. As illustrated in Fig. 2,
this lightweight composition transforms the weakly organized spatial structure of raw V AE latents

that spatial structure is critical to effective representation alignment, we use these composed dense
features as supervisory

benefit the generator without constraining its internal feature space?CoV A
addresses this by shifting the role of the composer from representation supervision to conditioning. At
later stages, CoV A removes the intermediate alignment objective and reuses the composer's detached
class posterior for sample-dependent Soft Label Conditioning. The V AE-derived signal thus evolves
from shaping internal features to modulating class conditioning as training progresses.
A closer analysis reveals a hidden confound in naive soft label conditioning. Forming a soft condition
by averaging class embeddings changes two factors simultaneously: its semantic direction and its
magnitude. The latter unintentionally alters the strength of class conditioning, making it difficult to
distinguish gains from semantic interpolation from those caused by weaker or stronger conditioning.

conditioning lowers FID Heusel et al. (2017) and improves Precision, but also
reduces Recall Kynkäänniemi et al. (2019), revealing a clear quality–diversity trade-off. Controlled
ablations show that this trade-off is largely driven by the unintended magnitude change. CoV A

ily for reconstruction rather than semantic organization. CoV A therefore learns a lightweight online
composer that reorganizes the clean V AE latent into a representation better suited for intermediate
supervision.

patches and dz is the patch dimension. A lightweight ViT-based composer Dosovitskiy et al. (2020)
Fθ produces dense patch featuresH∈R N×d h and class logitso∈R K:
(H,o) =F θ(Z),H= [h 1, . . . ,hN ],(3)
whereKdenotes the number of classes.
The composer is trained online with complementary semantic and spatial objectives:
Lcomp =L cls +λ mimLmim +λ flipLflip.(4)
Here, Lcls is a label-smoothed classification loss Szegedy et al. (2016), Lmim performs masked

Generation quality assessment.We report FID Heusel et al. (2017), sFID Nash et al. (2021),
IS Salimans et al. (2016), Precision, and Recall Kynkäänniemi et al. (2019). We generate 50K
samples from the EMA model using the SDE Euler–Maruyama solver with 250 integration steps,
and evaluate against ImageNet reference statistics. Classifier-free guidance Ho & Salimans (2022) is
disabled unless otherwise specified, and the same protocol is used for all methods.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Standard Inception-v3-based distribution metrics and Spatial LDS provide external measurement of generation quality and spatial organization, independent of the composer's training objectives.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are established by standard generative benchmarks on 50k samples against ImageNet reference statistics: FID, sFID, Inception Score, Precision, and Recall, plus Spatial LDS on validation latents.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The system is shaped by the flow-matching objective combined with intermediate cosine feature alignment to composer features and late-stage magnitude-corrected soft label conditioning derived from the online composer's classification, masked reconstruction, and flip-consistency losses.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims of accelerated convergence and improved generation metrics without relying on large external teachers (like DINO or CLIP) are well substantiated by matched-budget comparisons and extensive control experiments. The analytical and empirical demonstration of the soft-label magnitude confound is thoroughly validated through directional decompositions and null-centered scaling baselines.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The framework is evaluated systematically on class-conditional ImageNet 256x256 across multiple SiT model scales (B/2, L/2, XL/2) using established standard metrics including FID, sFID, Inception Score, Precision, and Recall. The paper features comprehensive ablation studies isolating the composer objectives, stopping schedules, and the magnitude confound in soft conditioning.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Standard image distribution metrics (FID, sFID, IS, Precision, Recall) evaluated externally via standard Inception-v3 features on generated samples.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard generative benchmarking on 50k samples using reference dataset distributions: Frechet Inception Distance (FID), sFID, Inception Score, and Precision/Recall, alongside Spatial LDS on validation latents.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Flow-matching loss combined with intermediate cosine feature alignment and late-stage magnitude-corrected soft label conditioning derived from the online composer's classification and MIM objectives.

primary.limitations: The work explicitly notes the stage sensitivity of representation alignment and soft label conditioning, requiring thresholded scheduling. Evaluations are scoped primarily to class-conditional ImageNet 256x256 under SiT backbones.
primary.method_assessment: The method is clearly formulated with formal descriptions of the composer loss, cosine feature alignment, alignment early stopping, and magnitude-corrected soft label conditioning to decouple directional semantic interpolation from embedding attenuation. Experimental protocols, architectural details, and hyperparameters are thoroughly documented.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript provides a well-scoped, rigorously tested contribution to diffusion transformer training dynamics. The experiments thoroughly investigate the proposed mechanisms with appropriate controls and ablations, meeting the standard for inclusion.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces CoVA, an online training scheme for flow-matching diffusion transformers that reorganizes VAE representations using an auxiliary latent composer trained with classification, masked reconstruction, and flip-consistency objectives. CoVA performs intermediate feature alignment early in training, transitions to magnitude-corrected soft label conditioning using the detached composer posterior late in training, and discards all auxiliary parameters at inference.
